what: It develops real estate projects on land in Latin America, including Costa Rica.
risks: Property development carries sales risk and building risk, such as cost overruns and delays, so its projects may not succeed.
It will need a lot more money after this offering, and there is serious doubt it can keep operating without extra financing.
Political, legal and financial problems in the Latin American countries where it works could hurt its business.
It is a young company with a short track record, and its controls and compliance habits are untested.
Its projects are in countries with different currencies, so exchange rate swings could make its reported results less steady.
